inputs.message: The bathroom shower keeps dripping into the tray even when it is turned off. There is no puddle outside.

guidance.name: Contained shower drip
guidance.message_key: the shower is dripping into the tray. the bathroom floor is completely dry.

snapshot.message: The shower is dripping into the tray. The bathroom floor is completely dry.

guidance.notes: A drip into the tray with a dry bathroom floor is a contained shower drip. Quote the first sentence and identify the shower as the fitting.

interpretation.evidence: The shower is dripping into the tray.
